letter_deductions.deduction: Less: Eye kit and drape - List III (part of procedure charges)
Less: Cataract limit (right eye), balance available INR 25,000.00
Less: Sum insured balance for the policy year INR 9,600.00
letter_deductions.why: SI used is only the 49,400 paid (or 52,000 admitted) on the LRTI claim; the rejected 41,000 claim used nothing. Balance 50,600 / 48,000 > 23,750, so no cap (Clause 2, 3.47).

notes: Insurer's balance 9,600 = 1,00,000 - 41,000 (rejected claim) - 49,400; counting a rejected claim against the SI is wrong. Either convention for SI used (paid 49,400 or admitted 52,000) leaves more than 23,750.
